evidence.note: Falsifiable claim: the lane sheet can name the step that killed a stopped lane (last_event_kind + mid_gate) instead of 'reason unknown', and recover_auto.decide can classify an expired lease+salvageable worktree as alone-settleable while refusing adopted/operator-answer/unmeasurable. Refuting observation: a lane with no gate event has a non-empty mid_gate. Probe: tests/test_lanes_watchdog.py (synthetic corpses) asserting last_event_kind/mid_gate/remedy and decide() effects; runs FAIL pre-fix (fields absent) and PASS with them.

Followed r-small-files, r-unavailable-not-pass, r-untrusted-data (mid_gate/last_event_kind read from events as data, remedy passed through safe()), r-derive-dont-store (ledger stays a pure function of events+state). Recorded recovery_auto as a pure module with no I/O.

Extended services/lanes ledger Lane with last_event_kind/mid_gate/remedy; _scan + _mid_gates + remedy_for; new services/lanes/recover_auto.py pure decision; advise _resume + render_ledger surface the remedy; committed on ddflow/lanes-watchdog (e7f9526e1, 8556b60a0, 8ba9e4505, 05a48e829). 7 files.

Rubber-duck review of the change: confirm _mid_gates keeps only the latest gate.started with no later outcome (a prior concluded round is not mid-run); confirm remedy_for returns '' for done/live lanes; confirm decide() checks adopted and operator_answer BEFORE salvageable so neither is ever auto; confirm render appends ONE line per stopped lane (safe()-flattened) so a hostile name stays one line; confirm Lane new fields are end-appended with defaults so existing positional constructions test_lanes.py still pass.

ruff check + ruff format clean on all changed files (0 issues); pure modules (recover_auto_, remedy_for) no I/O; single definition per concern (safe() shared, one decide() and one remedy_for()); no new deps, no secrets, no new files outside ddflow/services/lanes + tests.

No new bug introduced. Scoped tests: 526 passed / 0 failed from files this item changed (the 6 ci failures are baseline-red on main, bug Be3461fc98e, untouched files). recover_auto.decide guardrail order verified (adopted/operator-answer before salvageable); remedy_for returns '' for done/live lanes.

No duplicate of an existing ddflow feature: recover_auto.decide is new (core/recovery_plan.triage is the recover --all brain; lanes watchdog has no auto-decision today); last_event_kind/mid_gate are new Lane fields; no string/message duplication (single remedy_for, single decide).
